edits.before: E pull joins... no — your dash threat begins: Q-mark into E reset chases are live; trade on every landed crescent.
edits.after: Level 3 his Q-W-E all-in is online: Living Shadow doubles the shurikens while your reset does not exist yet.

edits.before: Mark-dash trades on cooldown — Q, E to the mark, passive three-hit, walk. The lane respects the curve now.
edits.after: Living Shadow is 20s at rank 1 — until it is spent his combo out-damages anything you can trade back.

edits.before: First item spike: the mark-dash combo chunks half bars and the reset chains through waves.
edits.after: Death Mark from fog beats a first item — he picks you before your rotation starts.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Pale Cascade like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Death Mark: 120s at rank 1, 100s at rank 3 — the mark triggers after 3 seconds, so your answer goes out inside that window, not before it lands. - Living Shadow is 20s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5; Shadow Slash resets every 5s down to 3s.

edits.before: The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Pale Cascade's third orb grows the shield — trade while orbs are out and his 6s Razor Shuriken chip does less.

edits.before: Q through the wave onto his chest, E the mark, three-hit string, walk — the phase trade he answers after you've left.
edits.after: When he swaps to Living Shadow he is 650 away and unmarked — Q first, then Lunar Rush onto the Moonlight for free.

edits.before: Zed burns Death Mark on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Death Mark is 120s at rank 1 — once he commits it, Moonfall him.

edits.before: That is Zed’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: He is untargetable for the Death Mark dash — burst thrown into it is burst wasted.

edits.before: Dashing onto an unmarked target with W down — Diana without the reset or the shield is a melee mage donating proximity.
edits.after: Shadow Slash slows off every shadow on a 3s cooldown — chasing him through the wave is chasing at his speed.

edits.before: Zed wins by landing Death Mark, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Zed wins by marking you untargetably, stacking damage for 3 seconds, and letting Death Mark repeat it back.

edits.before: Carry through the dive — mark, dash, pull, delete; your R turns their teamfight spacing into a suggestion.
edits.after: Zed flanks from fog with Death Mark — group, keep Moonfall for the moment he lands, and pull him off your carry.

notes: packet suspectName "Death Mark's" is a false positive. All seven full-layer sides were stale against a content chart that already matched the packet; rows 2, 3 and 5 moved to Zed with all three whys rewritten in the same proposal. Content whys[] and the early/mid/late prose here are written in third person about Diana rather than the site's second-person voice — left alone as a whole-array voice question, not a fact error. Whether Moonfall's pull can be used while Death-Marked to escape the mark's radius is asserted in content.mid already; not in Riot's text, so it was neither strengthened nor removed.
